subject: general
question: Linthoi Chanambam is associated with which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Judo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Linthoi Chanambam, **an Indian judoka, achieved a historic feat by clinching the **gold medal in the 57 kg **women's event at the **2022 World Judo Cadets Championships held in Sarajevo.**
 
• Representing India with pride, she emerged as the** first-ever Indian medalist **in any age category of the World Championships.
 
• Hailing from Manipur, Linthoi Chanambam has showcased exceptional talent and determination in her judo journey.
 
• Prior to her remarkable victory at the World Championships, Linthoi Chanambam had already showcased her prowess on the judo mat by securing a gold medal at the Asian Cadet and Junior Judo Championships, which took place in Bangkok.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Judo,** a **modern Japanese martial art **and** combat sport,** has gained widespread recognition as an Olympic sport since its inclusion in the Games in 1964.
 
• Founded in **1882 by Kanō Jigorō,** judo stands out for its emphasis on "randori" (free sparring) over "kata" (pre-arranged forms), a departure from traditional martial arts.
 
• Judo excludes striking and weapon training elements, distinguishing it from its predecessors. In competitive judo, the primary objective is to defeat the opponent by executing throws, immobilizing them with a pin, or compelling them to submit through joint locks or chokes.
 
• With its origins deeply rooted in Japanese culture and tradition, judo has evolved into a globally recognized sport, promoting physical fitness, mental discipline, and respect among practitioners worldwide.
